events.verdict: Huff (IND) initiates contact with Carter Jr.'s (ORL) arm as he contests the shot attempt.
Nembhard (IND) establishes himself in Banchero's (ORL) path prior to the contact.
Bane (ORL) fails to fully clear the lane and is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Siakam (IND) maintains verticality as he defends Banchero's (ORL) shot attempt.
Cain (ORL) and Nembhard (IND) briefly engage and disengage during the inbound.
Cain (ORL) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Pacers.
Nesmith (IND) releases away from Cain (ORL) as he spins away from the contact.
Siakam (IND) turns away from Bane (ORL) as he defends the shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) dislodges the ball from Huff (IND) during rebounding.  Any ensuing body contact that occurs after the ball is dislodged is considered incidental.
Carter Jr. (ORL) commits a take foul on Siakam (IND).
Cain (ORL) is moving alongside Siakam's (IND) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Walker (IND) throws the ball off Banchero's (ORL) foot, and Banchero does not intentionally kick the ball on the play.
Nembhard (IND) initiates contact with Banchero's (ORL) arm, and the contact affects his ability to gather the ball.
Siakam (IND) establishes himself in Cain's (ORL) path prior to the contact.
Cain (ORL) legally contests Siakam's (IND) jump shot attempt.
Banchero (ORL) clamps and holds Nesmith's (IND) left arm, and initiates contact with Nesmith's right shoulder that affects his control of the ball.
da Silva (ORL) establishes himself in Siakam's (IND) path prior to the contact.
Siakam (IND) makes contact with the ball as he defends Banchero's (ORL) shot attempt.
